name: Simple Secret Registration Code
description: Adds a secret-code field to the user registration form so only people who know the code can register (invite-code gating). The code is a SHARED SECRET — a weak or leaked code opens registration to anyone; use a strong code, rotate it, and pair with email verification/anti-spam.
project_description:
This module provides a simple secret registration code feature on user registration form. You can add either single or multiple secret registration codes.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Go to Manage Secret Registration Code page: Configuration » Manage secret registration code (admin/config/ssrc) 
 Add secret code 
 Enable Secret Registration Code 
 Save 
 
 After these steps, all anonymous user will see the Registration code field on user registration page.
